variant.description: A specific purchasable configuration of a physical item.

attributes.description: Freeform key-value map. Common keys: size, color, material, edition.

itemRef.description: The AT-URI's own collection segment already identifies what kind of record this points to (at://did/{collection}/rkey) -- no separate type field is stored here to avoid duplicating that. Older records written before this change may still carry an itemType field; it's not read.

variantSku.description: For physical items: which variant was purchased.

ref.description: A plain AT-URI + CID pointer to another record, used where no item-specific fields (like itemRef's variantSku) apply -- e.g. purchase.receipt's listing, licenseGrant, and grantedItems entries.

territories.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes. Interpreted per scope.

bazaarIdentifier.description: A self-issued, cryptographically signed identifier generated by the Bazaar backend at upload time. Serves as a non-colliding, ownership-evidentiary stand-in for institutional identifiers (ISRC, ISWC, UPC) until formal registration is obtained. Generated as base32(SHA-256(canonicalPayload)) where the payload always includes the artist's DID, ensuring global uniqueness without a registry. Signed by the Bazaar app service keypair (appDid) rather than the artist's personal ATProto keypair — ATProto OAuth does not expose the artist's private key to the application. Ownership is proven transitively: the app signed this identifier using its service keypair, and wrote the containing record to the artist's PDS using an OAuth session the artist granted. Verifiers resolve appDid to obtain the app's public verification key. Mutability: id, sig, kid, and generatedAt are immutable once written — mutating them destroys the evidentiary value of the assertion. The supersededBy* fields are the only mutable parts, populated when institutional registration is obtained.

id.description: The self-issued identifier. Prefixed by type: bazaar:rid:* for recordings, bazaar:wid:* for works/compositions, bazaar:pid:* for products/releases.

sig.description: Base64url signature by the storefront service keypair (storefrontDid) over the canonical identifier payload. The artist's DID is embedded in the payload but is not the signing key. Verifiers resolve storefrontDid — not the artist's DID document — to obtain the public verification key. Use the kid field to identify which historical storefront keypair produced this signature. Immutable.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp of identifier generation. Combined with the PDS record's creation timestamp forms a tamper-evident assertion of when ownership was first claimed. Immutable.

kid.description: Key identifier for the storefront service keypair that produced sig. Format: storefront-key-{YYYY-MM-DD} where the date is the keypair's activation date, e.g. storefront-key-2026-08-29. Used by verifiers to select the correct historical key from the storefrontDid DID document verificationMethod array when the storefront keypair has been rotated. kid is a hint — verifiers still verify cryptographically and should fall back to trying all non-revoked keys if the hinted key fails. Immutable.

supersededByIsrc.description: Populated when a proper ISRC is obtained. The bazaar:rid remains valid as the historical assertion record.

supersededByIswc.description: Populated when a proper ISWC is obtained. The bazaar:wid remains valid as the historical assertion record.

supersededByUpc.description: Populated when a proper UPC is obtained. The bazaar:pid remains valid as the historical assertion record.
